author: Silver Cymbal
description:
Mosquitoes can ruin your summer! Spraying is expensive & doesn't last long. This trap is different and can destroy the mosquito population where it starts, eggs. This simple to build DIY mosquito trap is cheap and works without toxic chemicals. My version solves all the problems of the popular "bucket of doom" people commonly experience.

Materials:
Black Bucket:  https://amzn.to/4mzexS4
Mosquito Bits: https://amzn.to/3QkFXPJ
Mosquito Donuts: https://amzn.to/41E7Jcr
Dowels: https://amzn.to/4dXapZY
Screw Pack, Stainless: https://amzn.to/4dSeoXK
